'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tim Murray DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Murray]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
